answer: An identity earns influence only as age locks release in tiers. Each tier requires a verifiable delay function tied to pubkey and seed, proving real time since genesis. Full participation needs twenty epochs. A clone spawning a thousand keys faces an ocean of fresh identities, each at tier zero with no weight. The aging path is a relic no shortcut bypasses, since VDF output cannot be parallelized or precomputed across keys. Even if an attacker spreads like a falcon over many perches, each puppet ages at the same glacial pace. Sybil cost stays linear per identity, no economy of scale.
